Strike at the Dah Loh ( 大陸 ) Iron Works,
situated at Tan Ts Wan, Chapel.

At 5 p.m. on 25.9.40., Mr. K. Sasaki (佐佐木孝一),
Japanese, in charge of the Personnel Department of the
Dah Loh Iron Works, (owned by the Saigai Wata Kaisha),
situated at Tan Ts Wan ( 譚子灣 ) near West Kwang Poh Rd.,
Chapel, came to the station and reported to the effect
that some 150 male workers of the Machinery department
of the above concern had declared a strike at about 7:30
a.m. even date.

Mr. Sasaki stated that the iron works is operated
with a complement of 300 workers and is divided into 3
departments, namely:- Welding Department, Moulding
Department and the Machinery Department. The following
demands were submitted to the management by the repre-
sentatives of the strikers:-

(1) Present wages be increased by 50%.
(2) Each worker be paid with an allowance of 1%
of the market price of rice every month.
(3) The system of stipulated job-work be abolish-
ed.
(4) No workers should be dismissed after the
settlement of the strike.
(5) The above demands be taken into effect
immediately.

From enquiries made, it was ascertained that
there were no signs of strike on the part of the workers
of the other two departments and they were carrying on

位于闸北谭子湾的大陆铁厂罢工事件。

1940年9月25日下午5时，日本人佐佐木孝一（K. Sasaki）先生前来警署报案。佐佐木先生系西外渡会社（Saigai Wata Kaisha）所有、位于闸北广北路（West Kwang Poh Rd.）附近谭子湾的大陆铁厂人事部主管。据称，该厂机械部约150名男工于当日早上7时30分左右宣布罢工。

佐佐木先生称，该铁厂共有工人300名，分为三个部门，即：焊接部、造型部和机械部。罢工代表向管理层提出了以下要求：

(1) 现有工资增加50%。
(2) 每月按大米市场价格的1%向每名工人发放津贴。
(3) 废除规定的计件工作制。
(4) 罢工解决后不得解雇任何工人。
(5) 立即实施上述要求。

经查询获悉，其他两个部门的工人并无罢工迹象，他们正在安静地

Two strike ringleaders named NYI TS PING
(倪士平) and TSU PEI KUNG (朱培根), both residing in
Zau Ka Doo Village, were reported to have been taken into
custody by the Japanese Military Police of the ZAU KA
DOO Branch, Robison Road, U.U.L., at about 12 noon on
25.9.40. and are still being detained for interrogation.

Mr. Sasaki requested that Settlement Police
be posted at the Ichang Road Bridge between 6 a.m. and
7 a.m. 26.9.40. to prevent agitators from interfering
with those loyal workers living in the Settlement whilst
on their way to work.

D.S. 648.

A.C. Rossi

据报道，两名罢工头目倪士平（NYI TS PING）和朱培根（TSU PEI KUNG），均居住在曹家渡村，于1940年9月25日中午12时左右被罗宾森路（Robison Road）、极司菲尔路（U.U.L.）曹家渡分遣队的日本宪兵队拘留，目前仍在羁押中接受讯问。

佐佐木先生请求在1940年9月26日早上6时至7时之间，在宜昌路桥部署租界警察，以防止煽动者干扰居住在租界内、正在上班途中的忠诚工人。
